appDesc.message: Reads live subtitles from any page, translates them instantly with DeepL into the language of your choice, in a movable floating window, with a saveable transcript.

ov_tip_save.message: Save the transcript to a .txt file

ov_dlg_hint.message: The file contains both the original and the translated lines, with timestamps.

ov_hint_nokey.message: First add your DeepL API key under ⚙, then press Start.

ov_hint_ready.message: Ready. Turn on subtitles in the player, then press Start.

ov_hint_start.message: Press Start. If no subtitles arrive, click the ◎ picker and then the subtitle itself on the page.

ov_warn_nokey.message: No DeepL key — recording works, but without translation. Set it up under ⚙.

ov_pick_active.message: Click the subtitle on the page — ESC to cancel

ov_stale.message: The extension was reloaded — refresh the page (F5) to make it work again.

cap_pick_tip.message: Click the subtitle — ESC to cancel

cap_pick_tip_iframe.message: Note: the player is in a separate frame ($1) — the picker does not work over the video. Allow it in Diagnostics first.

cap_pick_on_overlay.message: You clicked the translator window. Drag it away from the subtitle, then press the picker again.

cap_pick_uichrome.message: That is a link or a button, not a subtitle — nothing was saved. Pick again, directly on the subtitle text.

cap_pick_nothing.message: No element found there. Pick again, directly on the subtitle text.

cap_pick_noselector.message: Could not identify that element — try clicking one level up, around the text.

cap_pick_notext.message: The selected element has no text right now. If subtitles are off, turn them on (CC) and pick again. If subtitles are visible but no text arrives here, they are burned into the video image and cannot be read from the DOM.

cap_target_lost.message: The selected subtitle element was lost. Turn subtitles on, or pick again.

cap_switched_to_track.message: No text arrived from the selected element, so I switched to the video’s own subtitle track.

cap_no_source_iframe.message: The player is in a separate frame ($1), so I cannot see inside it — the picker cannot reach it either. Extension icon → Diagnostics → “Allow: $1”, then reload the page.

cap_no_source.message: No subtitle text found. Turn on subtitles in the player, or select them with the ◎ picker.

pop_bad_page.message: Extensions cannot run on this kind of page.

pop_note_nokey.message: No DeepL API key yet. Recording works, but without translation. Set it up below.

pop_perm_denied.message: Permission denied, so it cannot run here.

pop_enabled_reload.message: Allowed. Reload the page (F5) and the window will appear.

pop_diag_noframes.message: No frame responded. Reload the page (F5).

pop_track_ok.message: ✓ Text is readable from the video’s own subtitle track:

pop_target_ok.message: ✓ The selected element exists and has text:

pop_target_empty.message: The selected element exists but is empty — are subtitles turned on?

pop_target_missing.message: The selected element was not found. Pick again.

pop_rule_delete.message: Delete rule (back to the subtitle track)

pop_guess_set.message: Use this as the subtitle source

pop_no_video.message: No video and no subtitle-like element in this frame — the player is probably in an embedded frame.

pop_no_text.message: There is a video but no subtitle text. Turn on subtitles and run this again — if it still fails, they may be burned into the video image.

pop_iframes_intro.message: Embedded frames on this page — the player is almost certainly the first one. Allow it so I can see inside:

pop_iframes_unknown.message: $1 more frame(s) with an unknown source — those cannot be identified.

opt_sub.message: Reads live subtitles, translates them instantly into the language of your choice, saveable transcript.

opt_s1_hint.message: Free keys end in :fx — the extension uses that to pick the right DeepL endpoint, so you can enter a Pro key later just as well.

opt_key_warn.message: The key is stored unencrypted in the browser’s own storage on this machine. Do not use it on a shared computer.

opt_key_saved.message: Saved. Use the “Test” button to verify it.

opt_lang_label.message: Target language — subtitles are translated into this

opt_lang_hint.message: DeepL detects the source language automatically, so English, German, Spanish and the rest all work — you only choose what to translate into.

opt_lang_needkey.message: Add your DeepL key first to fetch the current list.

opt_lang_failed.message: Could not fetch the language list.

opt_s2_hint.message: The extension only runs on the sites listed here. Enter the site’s domain (e.g. example.com) — subpages and subdomains are included automatically.

opt_domain_nogrant.message: no permission — remove it and add it again

opt_domain_invalid.message: That is not a valid domain. For example: example.com

opt_domain_exists.message: It is already on the list.

opt_delay_label.message: Close a sentence after this pause

opt_delay_hint.message: Shorter = faster subtitles, more DeepL calls and more cut-off sentences. Longer = better translation, 1–3 seconds of lag.

opt_bilingual_label.message: Bilingual view by default (original + translation, one above the other)

opt_s3_hint.message: Font size, opacity and view mode can also be set per site in the window, where they are remembered. These are only the defaults.

opt_s4_hint.message: Elements selected with the picker, per site. If subtitle detection breaks on a site, delete the rule here and pick again.

opt_target_none.message: No subtitle element selected yet. The extension tries to read the video’s own subtitle track.

opt_confirm_clear.message: Delete every recorded transcript? This cannot be undone.

opt_footer.message: Shortcuts: Alt+Shift+T show/hide the window · Alt+Shift+S start/stop capturing. They can be rebound at chrome://extensions/shortcuts.

dl_err_key.message: Invalid or expired DeepL key — check it in the settings.

dl_err_toolong.message: The request text is too long.

dl_err_rate.message: Too many requests — DeepL is throttling temporarily.

dl_err_quota.message: The monthly DeepL quota is used up. Recording continues, just without translation.

dl_err_server.message: The DeepL service is temporarily unavailable.
